restaurantName: Chả Cá Anh Vũ (Ô Chợ Dừa)
address: 120-K1 Giang Vo Street, O Cho Dua Ward, Hanoi, 11511, Vietnam
bio: Having been in the city for over 20 years, this bouncy family-run operation offers slick service. The homely vibe is depicted by chequered tablecloths, patterned wallpaper and brightly painted murals. Chả cá, grilled catfish seasoned with turmeric, is the name of the game here; its tender, juicy flesh carries a delicate aroma. You can also add nem cá, fish spring rolls; canh cá, fish soup; and lòng cá, fish stomach, as extras. The fresh, tasty food delivers an explosion of flavours and textures.
pageTitle: Chả Cá Anh Vũ (Ô Chợ Dừa)
